shortDescription: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck China's Tibet region on Sunday, according to the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre.The quake was at a depth of 9 km (5 miles), EMSC added.An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck the region last week, killing 16 people.

children: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck China's Tibet region on Sunday, according to the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre.
The quake was at a depth of 9 km (5 miles), EMSC added.
An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck the region last week, killing 16 people.
